summary: Official Sichuan sources establish a local registration custodian and public land-information procedures, but no anonymous public parcel ID plus geometry response was verified. No sample GeoJSON is retained; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Chinese discovery queries are recorded in city-8107-neijiang.json. Results identified the official Sichuan service catalog, Sichuan government report, national registration-center directory and map-service directory entry.
requestOutcomes: Official service, government report, national registry directory and map-directory pages were reachable through public GET/search inspection, but none exposed an anonymous parcel feature service, schema, CRS or safe native parcel identity. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe fields or TLS-disable action was used.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [29.5953558235259, 105.058962701695] was preserved; no exact-point hit/miss inference was made.
No Neijiang city boundary or complete city coverage was established for an open geometry service.
No parcel geometry, stable native parcel identity, source schema or CRS was retrieved or retained.
Official registration custody/procedure evidence is not treated as proof of an open vector parcel API.
A map extent miss, inaccessible viewer or absent public endpoint is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account or personal fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter; serial reviewer qualification remains pending.
